goal: One red-and-yellow ball, large in the middle of a white card, so a child can name it.

Exactly one ball: no second one, no copies, and nothing else in the picture. The background is plain white and empty, with at most a very soft shadow under the ball. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. The picture is for young children and is rated G.
